subject: Music Production
title: Dr. Dre and West Coast Rap
description: A short lesson to help you apply Dr. Dre and West Coast Rap.

hook.text: Andre Young built beats in a Compton garage, layering funk samples with heavy bass and synths.

buildup.text: As Dr. Dre, he produced NWA's debut and defined the aggressive sound of West Coast gangsta rap.

discovery.text: Dre's 'The Chronic' introduced G-funk, blending Parliament samples with smooth synthesizers.

twist.text: He discovered Eminem and 50 Cent, launching two more careers that dominated global charts.

climax.text: Dr. Dre's production empire generated billions in music sales and built Beats Electronics.

punchline.text: A Compton garage beat-maker built a music empire.

quiz.question: What style did Dr. Dre pioneer with 'The Chronic'?
options: G-funk blending Parliament samples with synths
